title: zazz-worker source component diagram
description: One module per job behind main.rs's dispatch. serve.rs and testrun.rs both run instances through run.rs, which uses engine.rs's shared engine and net.rs's policy check; serve uses real HTTPS, test mode a replay file.

components.name: zazz-worker source
components.responsibility: Compiles, tests and runs zazz WebAssembly scripts for zazzled.

components.name: Entry (main.rs)
components.responsibility: Dispatches compile, serve, test and version; parses the test options and the replay file; prints errors as `zazz-worker: ...` with exit status 1.

components.name: Engine (engine.rs)
components.responsibility: One wasmtime engine (epoch interruption, Cranelift optimised for speed) for compiling and loading, so precompiled modules load; refuses imports outside wasi_snapshot_preview1 and the five zazz_host functions and modules without _start; advances the epoch every 10 ms.

components.name: Instances (run.rs)
components.responsibility: Runs one fresh instance: WASI preview 1 with the preopens, arguments, environment and streams, the zazz_host imports, a memory limit and an epoch deadline; classifies the ending as exit, timeout, out of memory or crash.

components.name: Serve mode (serve.rs)
components.responsibility: Loads the module from fd 4, reads frames and descriptors from fd 3, turns the hello into the per-worker setup, runs each call in a fresh instance and writes its result (or a structured error) back; relays progress at once; reports cancellation when another frame is waiting.

components.name: Test mode (testrun.rs)
components.responsibility: Runs a test module with the scratch directory as `.`, optional snapshots, the replay file as the network and captured output: each libtest test in its own instance, or a test command whose test-report message (else exit status) decides; at most 20 failures with capped messages.

components.name: Network (net.rs)
components.responsibility: The Backend trait: Https (ureq, no redirects, a time limit, 16 MiB bodies) and Replay (recorded method and URL pairs, anything else refused); send checks the policy first.

components.name: zazz-sdk (lib zazz)
components.responsibility: proto, fdpass, Json, Error and http, shared with zazzled and the scripts.

components.name: wasmtime and wasmtime-wasi
components.responsibility: The WebAssembly runtime and WASI preview 1.
